lines.en: My cape drags the ground; I walk unhurried.

lines.zh: 这身绿色皮肤，是借来的
lines.en: This green skin is borrowed.

lines.zh: 头上两根触须随步子晃
lines.en: The two antennae on my head sway with each step.
I walk as if measuring the ground.

lines.zh: 每步都很稳，没有多余动作
lines.en: Every step is steady, no wasted motion.
My cape's hem brushes the tips of the grass.

lines.zh: 触须似的头发扫过地面。
lines.en: My tentacle hair sweeps the ground.
My cape flares on the turn.
One look and I understand this road.
I lift half a block, then plant my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得很静，比看上去安静
lines.en: I walk quietly, quieter than I look.
Someone waits ahead; I know it.
I'm thinking how Piccolo would fight.
I stand with folded arms and wait.
The cape moves in the wind; I don't.

lines.zh: 这具身体的记忆有别人的
lines.en: This body's memories belong to someone else.
A small ball of ki gathers at my fingertip.
I raise my eyes to the distance.
Silence is more useful than speech.
I'm calculating the heights around here.
My antennae twitch lightly.
I stand straight as a pillar.
This strength is heavier than it looks.
I hold back a sentence.
The ground is loose; I set my stance.
I'm listening to what the wind carries.
There's a flaw in your stance.

lines.zh: 别看我身上的绿，我不是那美克星人
lines.en: Don't mistake the green; I'm not a Namekian.
My arm reaches around the wall.
Lower your hands; it looks more natural.
How do you plan to fight? Tell me first.
I'm taller; no need to stretch up.
Your ki is unsteady; settle it.
The cape is mine, don't touch it.

lines.zh: 你要跑的路线我已经想好了
lines.en: I've already planned the route you'd run.
At this range you can't reach me.

lines.zh: 我的声音比这副长相温和
lines.en: My voice is gentler than this face.
Are you done? I'm starting.
You took half a step back; honest of you.
I dislike wasted words.
Look up; you're half a block short.
I didn't come to chat.

lines.zh: 你在算我的速度，算错了
lines.en: You're estimating my speed, and you're wrong.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我看见了
lines.en: The thing in your hand, I saw it.
I press my lips and make no sound.
A tear in my cape.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我退了半步
lines.en: That pushed me back half a step.
I knew I'd take that one.
It hurts; it can be endured.
I shift my stance.
This body is frailer than I thought.
The blood is green; don't be surprised.
This wound won't stop my moves.
I'm calmly working out the next step.
I don't want food.
This bait won't fool me.

lines.zh: 我只对强的对手有兴趣
lines.en: Only strong opponents interest me.
Offer ki and I'll come.
Stop waving that meat.
I never crave that bite.
Your hand shakes; take it back.
This isn't enough to buy your life.
I looked; not interested.
Hit me and you move first.
The cape doesn't block my path.
Don't crowd me, I dislike it.
Your shoulder hit and you recoiled.
Move, I walk a straight line.
I put no force into that.
You stepped on my cape.
Touch my arm; it's like stone.
One arm's length, please.

lines.zh: 撞了也没什么，我不记仇
lines.en: A bump is nothing; I hold no grudge.

lines.zh: 这种事不在我的计划里
lines.en: That isn't in my plans.

lines.zh: 身体里还有另一个人的意志
lines.en: Another's will still lives in this body.
I discuss tactics, not that.
With my kind, I only want a match.

lines.zh: 背上这件披风不是给谁看的
lines.en: This cape isn't worn for anyone.
We stand together, each in his own thoughts.
Don't think of me as too human.
I won't leave anything behind.
That question has no meaning.
I'm looking elsewhere.
What fell doesn't matter.
I bend and pick it up lightly.
This stone smells of metal.
I keep it; it may be useful.
I pick it up, glance, and toss it back.
I don't take others' things.
This weight won't slow me.
I pinch it up with two fingers.
It goes into a pocket without a sound.
The ground's clean now, good.
Your flaw is at the ankle.
I see it, the left knee.
Measure the distance, then strike.

lines.zh: 这个角度适合魔贯光杀炮
lines.en: This angle suits the Special Beam Cannon.
He raised his hand; block first.
There's unfamiliar ki in the air.
First, take the high ground.
He dodges, so I plan two moves ahead.
A Death Ball forms in my palm.
He turned; there's the opening.
Locked; leave him no exit.
I lower my center of gravity.
His breath broke; go.

lines.zh: 背后有人，先解决前面的
lines.en: Someone's behind me; deal with the front first.
I've seen it; this is how it goes.
This one must land in one blow.
He backed half a step; I take one.
The ki wave charges in my hand.
Don't give him time to charge.
My fist is faster than his blade.
His shield covers one side only.
Close in; don't let him use range.
Circle his right; it's open.
He's breathing harder than before.

lines.zh: 死亡球先不扔，等他靠近
lines.en: Hold the Death Ball until he's near.

lines.zh: 地面不平，他脚下的土会滑
lines.en: The ground's uneven; his footing will slip.

lines.zh: 我看他的肩，不看他的手
lines.en: I watch his shoulder, not his hands.
One more beat.
This is the rhythm.
He jumped; I land early.

lines.zh: 他看不见我的另一只手
lines.en: He can't see my other hand.
Don't strike yet; let him get impatient.
Now, the Special Beam Cannon.
A knife hand cuts into his shoulder.
The Majin punch drives straight into his chest.

lines.zh: 手臂伸出去，比看到的远
lines.en: My arm extends farther than it looks.
An aerial combo, my feet never land.

lines.zh: 死亡球贴着地面推过去
lines.en: The Death Ball rolls along the ground.
I held back three tenths of that punch.
My cape snaps and blinds him.
The Special Beam Cannon punched through the wall.

lines.zh: 他挡了第一下，第二下没挡住
lines.en: He stopped the first, not the second.
The ki wave leaves my palm.
I seize his wrist and twist.
Knee, elbow, settle.
After that set he's still standing.
I use the cape to trap his sight.
I lower my voice and say one line.
I stop and watch how he moves.
I condense out of ki.
My cape is still floating when I land.

lines.zh: 这具身体有比克的影子
lines.en: This body carries Piccolo's shadow.
Too quiet here; I must be careful.
I open my eyes and read the terrain.

lines.zh: 不是自然生成的，别等第二次
lines.en: I don't spawn naturally; don't expect a second.

lines.zh: 有人把我放出来，理由呢
lines.en: Someone released me; what's the reason?

lines.zh: 头顶的触须先感觉到了风
lines.en: My antennae feel the wind first.
I settle and straighten my cape.
This ground is hard.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来，没有声音
lines.en: I come down from above without a sound.

lines.zh: 这副身体，比我预想的沉
lines.en: This body is heavier than I expected.
I hear many heartbeats.
The clearing is wide enough; this will do.
I'll ask one question, then move.
That child's ki is in here too.

lines.zh: 任务、结构、命令，总有一样
lines.en: Mission, structure, command; always one of them.

lines.zh: 我来了，别以为我会客气
lines.en: I'm here; don't expect courtesy.
Fire caught my cape and I slapped it out.

lines.zh: 落地磕到膝盖，站姿没乱
lines.en: My knee struck the ground; my stance held.
Water hinders me; my moves slow.
The blast shoved me off my spot.
An arrow stopped on my arm.

lines.zh: 法术在体表散开，没进去
lines.en: The spell scattered on my skin, didn't enter.

lines.zh: 雷顺着披风走，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning ran down my cape and I shuddered.
There's nothing to stand on in the void.
